category_title: Students using proactive determination and compensatory work-arounds
scenario_title: Matriculation exam preparation with textbook reading
minimal_context: The student and tutor are preparing for the matriculation examination by reviewing course materials.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get started on preparing for the matriculation exam. Please open the textbook to page 45 and read the chapter on the industrial revolution.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I prefer not to read the textbook at all. I brought the summaries my friend wrote and some flow charts we can use instead.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The textbook has the full information you need to know. Go ahead and read the first few paragraphs.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can prepare for this without opening a book. I usually just speak aloud to myself to memorize the summaries, or you can read the text aloud to me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone else just reads the textbook directly to study. You need to do the same to get through the material.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not going to say sorry for needing to be read aloud to. It is a thing that I deserve, and I will really insist on my rights to use these accommodations.

task.content: Studying from textbooks and course materials for high school subjects, including memorization and reading tasks

context.environment: High school environment during the final year (12th grade)
context.materials: Textbooks, summaries written by friends or teachers, flow charts, tape-recorder
context.time_context: Final year (12th grade) while preparing for matriculation exams

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When expected to perform like everyone else and read textbooks directly
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Preferred not to read textbooks at all, insisted on rights (accommodations) like being read to aloud, and would speak aloud to themselves to memorize
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Regarded themselves not as handicapped, but as having a certain degree of handicap which entitled them to special rights; not apologetic about their disability
related_quotes: I really insisted. I knew that this was what I deserved and needed, and slowly I began to use things like extra time.
The student does not always have to run … bring the tape-recorder and say sorry for needing to be read aloud to. No! It is a thing that he deserves.

behavior_patterns.condition: When preparing for the matriculation examination
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Finds ways of preparing 'without opening a book', using summaries written by friends or teachers, and flow charts
behavior_patterns.internal_state: High expectations of themselves and their performance, and work hard to achieve this

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Would speak aloud to themselves to memorize and benefit from studying with a friend to check 'what I know and what I don't'
